desc: Derive the decomposition: f(x,y) = Σ_{i≤x} [A_i·cnt_B(A_i) − sum_B(A_i)] + Σ_{j≤y} [B_j·cnt_A(B_j) − sum_A(B_j)], where cnt_B/sum_B are over prefix multisets.

Identify that the 2D prefix × value-condition problem factorizes inside CDQ over value: within a node, all cross pairs (A_i ≥ B_j) qualify, so contributions factor as prefixSumA(x)·prefixCntB(y) − prefixCntA(x)·prefixSumB(y).

Design the concrete algorithm: T(x,y) = Σ_{i≤x,j≤y, A_i≥B_j} (A_i−B_j) computed via CDQ over compressed values (i-elements with weight A_i in one half, j-elements with weight B_j in other half); per CDQ node, sort elements by index and compute for each query (x,y): SA_I(x)·cntJ(y) − cntI(x)·SB_J(y) using prefix sums / two pointers; then F(x,y) = 2·T(x,y) − y·prefixSumA(x) + x·prefixSumB(y).

Implement in Python: read input, compress values, run CDQ (iterative or recursive with O((N+K) log N) per level, total O((N+K) log² N) or better), accumulate per-query answers as Python ints, output K lines.

Verify correctness on the two samples mentally or by reasoning, check edge cases (duplicates, x=y=N, values equal → contribute 0, large answers fit Python int), and ensure fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer, sorted merges rather than re-sorting per node where possible).
